description: Beginner-friendly foundations. Start here if you are new to English.

topics.title: Am / Is / Are
topics.description: The verb To Be for present facts.

lessons.title: Am / Is / Are (Positive & Negative)
lessons.explanation:
We use am/is/are to talk about facts, feelings, and jobs in the present.

Rule:
I am
He/She/It is
You/We/They are

(हम am/is/are का प्रयोग वर्तमान में तथ्य बताने के लिए करते हैं।)
lessons.rule: Always match the verb to the subject. (I am, She is, They are).

examples.hi: वह एक डॉक्टर है।
वे मेरे दोस्त हैं।
मैं भूखा नहीं हूँ।
वह यहाँ नहीं है।

lessons.title: I am doing...
lessons.explanation:
Use Present Continuous for things happening right now.

Structure: Subject + am/is/are + Verb-ing

(जो काम अभी हो रहा है, उसे बताने के लिए।)
lessons.rule: Do not forget the helping verb (am/is/are) before the -ing verb.

examples.hi: मैं किताब पढ़ रहा हूँ।
बारिश हो रही है।

examples.en: You are not listening to me!
examples.hi: तुम मेरी बात नहीं सुन रहे हो!
क्या तुम ठीक महसूस कर रहे हो?

lessons.title: I do / I work / I like
lessons.explanation:
Use Simple Present for habits or things that are generally true.

Rule: I/You/We/They + V1. He/She/It + V1+s/es.

(रोज़मर्रा की आदतें बताने के लिए।)
lessons.rule: Add s/es to the verb only if the subject is He, She, or It.

examples.hi: मैं हर सुबह चाय पीता हूँ।

examples.en: The earth goes round the sun.
examples.hi: पृथ्वी सूर्य के चारों ओर घूमती है।
उसे कॉफी पसंद नहीं है।

title: Detailed Grammar Course
description: Complete step-by-step grammar with Hindi + English rules and extensive practice.

topics.title: Chapter 1: Parts of Speech
topics.description: The 8 main categories of words based on their function.

lessons.title: Introduction to Parts of Speech
lessons.explanation:
Parts of Speech means the different categories of words according to the work/function they perform in a sentence.

There are 8 main Parts of Speech:
1. Noun
2. Pronoun
3. Verb
4. Adjective
5. Adverb
6. Preposition
7. Conjunction
8. Interjection
lessons.rule: Every word in an English sentence belongs to a specific part of speech based on its job.

examples.en: The intelligent boy quickly opened the old book.
examples.hi: बुद्धिमान लड़के ने जल्दी से पुरानी किताब खोली।
राजबाबू एक छात्र है।
वह तेज़ी से दौड़ती है।

topics.title: Chapter 2: Noun (संज्ञा)
topics.description: Types, number, countability, gender, and case of Nouns.

lessons.title: What is a Noun & Its Types
lessons.explanation:
A noun is a word used as the name of a person, place, animal, thing, substance, quality, feeling, or idea.
(किसी व्यक्ति, स्थान, वस्तु के नाम को Noun कहते हैं।)

Types:
- Proper Noun (Rajbabu, India)
- Common Noun (boy, city)
- Collective Noun (team, family)
- Abstract Noun (honesty, happiness)
- Material Noun (gold, water)
lessons.rule: Proper nouns normally begin with a capital letter (e.g., India, not india).

examples.en: Rajbabu bought a computer in Lucknow.
examples.hi: राजबाबू ने लखनऊ में एक कंप्यूटर खरीदा।
ईमानदारी एक अच्छा गुण है।
हमारी टीम ने मैच जीत लिया।

lessons.title: Countable vs Uncountable & Plurals
lessons.explanation:
Countable nouns can be counted (one book, two books).
Uncountable nouns refer to substances or mass (water, information).

Plural Rules:
Rule 1: Add -s (book -> books)
Rule 2: Ends in s, sh, ch, x -> add -es (box -> boxes)
Rule 3: Consonant + y -> ies (city -> cities)
Rule 4: Irregular (man -> men, child -> children)
lessons.rule: Do not use a/an directly with uncountable nouns (e.g., "some information", not "an information").

examples.hi: मैंने तीन किताबें खरीदीं।
उसने मुझे कुछ सलाह दी।
मेरे दो बच्चे हैं।

lessons.title: Subject & Object Pronouns
lessons.explanation:
A pronoun is used instead of a noun.

Subject Pronouns (do the action): I, you, he, she, it, we, they
Object Pronouns (receive the action): me, you, him, her, it, us, them
lessons.rule: Always use an Object Pronoun after a preposition (e.g., Between you and me).

examples.hi: उसने मेरी मदद की।
मैंने उसे फोन किया।
यह उपहार उसके लिए है।

lessons.title: Who vs Whom vs Whose
lessons.explanation:
Who = subject (Who called you?)
Whom = object (Whom did you meet?)
Whose = possession (Whose book is this?)
lessons.rule: Test for Who/Whom: Replace with he/him. If "he" fits -> Who. If "him" fits -> Whom.

examples.hi: आपको किसने फोन किया?
यह फोन किसका है?

examples.en: The boy who won the race is my friend.
examples.hi: वह लड़का जिसने दौड़ जीती, मेरा दोस्त है।

topics.title: Chapter 4: Verb (क्रिया)
topics.description: Action words, helping verbs, and verb forms.

lessons.title: Main Verbs & Helping Verbs
lessons.explanation:
A verb shows an action, state, or condition. (Verb किसी काम या अवस्था को बताता है।)

1. Action Verb (Main Verb): eat, run, play, sleep.
2. Helping Verb: is, am, are, was, were, has, have, had, do, does, did.
3. Modals: can, could, should, must, will.
lessons.rule: Every English sentence must have at least one verb.

examples.hi: मैं क्रिकेट खेलता हूँ।
मैं पढ़ाई कर रहा हूँ।

lessons.title: Verb Forms (V1 to V5)
lessons.explanation:
Verbs have 5 forms:

V1 (Base): go, eat
V2 (Past): went, ate
V3 (Past Participle): gone, eaten
V4 (Present Participle/-ing): going, eating
V5 (s/es): goes, eats
lessons.rule: V2 is only used in Simple Past tense. V3 is always used with has/have/had or in Passive Voice.

examples.hi: वह स्कूल गया।
उसने खाना खा लिया है।

topics.title: Chapter 5: Adjective (विशेषण)
topics.description: Describing words and degrees of comparison.

lessons.title: What is an Adjective?
lessons.explanation:
An adjective describes or gives more information about a noun or pronoun. (Adjective Noun या Pronoun की विशेषता बताता है।)

Examples: good, bad, tall, beautiful, red, five.
lessons.rule: Adjectives normally come BEFORE the noun (e.g., a "red car", not a "car red").

examples.hi: वह एक बुद्धिमान छात्र है।
मेरे पास एक लाल कार है।

lessons.title: Degrees of Comparison
lessons.explanation:
1. Positive (Normal): good, tall
2. Comparative (Compare 2 things): better, taller
3. Superlative (Compare 3+ things): best, tallest
lessons.rule: Always use "than" after Comparative degree. Always use "the" before Superlative degree.

examples.hi: राहुल अमित से लंबा है।

examples.en: She is the best student in the class.
examples.hi: वह कक्षा में सबसे अच्छी छात्रा है।

topics.title: Chapter 6: Adverb (क्रिया-विशेषण)
topics.description: Words that describe verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs.

lessons.title: Using Adverbs
lessons.explanation:
An adverb gives more information about a verb, adjective, or another adverb. It tells How, When, or Where. (यह बताता है कि काम कैसे, कब या कहाँ हुआ।)

Examples: quickly, slowly, yesterday, today, very, always.
lessons.rule: Many adverbs of manner end in "-ly" (quick -> quickly).

examples.hi: वह तेज़ी से दौड़ता है।
वह कल आई थी।

topics.title: Chapter 7: Preposition (संबंधबोधक)
topics.description: In, on, at, under, between, among.

lessons.title: Prepositions of Place & Time
lessons.explanation:
A preposition shows the relationship between a noun and another word. (यह जगह, समय, या दिशा बताता है।)

Time: at (exact time), on (days/dates), in (months/years).
Place: in (inside), on (surface), under (below).
lessons.rule: Use "between" for two things. Use "among" for more than two things.

examples.en: The book is on the table.
examples.hi: किताब मेज पर है।
मैं भारत में रहता हूँ।
क्लास सुबह 10 बजे शुरू होती है।

topics.title: Chapter 8: Conjunction (समुच्चयबोधक)
topics.description: Joining words and sentences (and, but, because, so).

lessons.title: Joining Sentences
lessons.explanation:
A conjunction joins words, phrases, or sentences. (यह शब्दों या वाक्यों को जोड़ता है।)

and -> addition
but -> contrast (विरोध)
or -> choice
because -> reason
so -> result
lessons.rule: Do not start a formal sentence with "Because".

examples.en: I wanted to go, but it was raining.
examples.hi: मैं जाना चाहता था, लेकिन बारिश हो रही थी।

examples.en: I stayed home because I was sick.
examples.hi: मैं घर पर रहा क्योंकि मैं बीमार था।

lessons.title: Simple Present & Continuous
lessons.explanation:
Simple Present (Habit/Truth): Sub + V1 (s/es)
Present Continuous (Happening Now): Sub + is/am/are + V1-ing
lessons.rule: Do not use continuous tense for state verbs (know, like, love, understand). Say "I understand", not "I am understanding".

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.
examples.hi: सूरज पूर्व से उगता है।
वे क्रिकेट खेल रहे हैं।

lessons.title: Simple Past vs Present Perfect
lessons.explanation:
Simple Past (Finished action in past): Sub + V2
Present Perfect (Past action with result now): Sub + has/have + V3
lessons.rule: If you mention an exact past time (yesterday, last year), you MUST use Simple Past, not Present Perfect.

examples.hi: मैंने कल एक फिल्म देखी।
मेरी चाबियाँ खो गई हैं।

topics.title: Chapter 11: Modals
topics.description: Can, Could, Should, Must, May, Might.

lessons.title: Using Modal Verbs
lessons.explanation:
Can (Ability)
Should (Advice)
Must (Obligation/Rule)
May (Permission/Possibility)
lessons.rule: Always use V1 after any modal verb. Never use "to" (except ought to / used to).

examples.hi: मैं अंग्रेजी बोल सकता हूँ।
तुम्हें रोज़ पढ़ना चाहिए।
तुम्हें हेलमेट ज़रूर पहनना चाहिए।

topics.title: Chapter 12: Active & Passive Voice
topics.description: Changing the focus of the sentence.

lessons.title: Converting to Passive
lessons.explanation: Active Voice focuses on WHO does the action. Passive Voice focuses on WHAT was done. (Active में कर्ता प्रधान, Passive में कर्म प्रधान)
lessons.rule: To make passive: Object becomes Subject + Be form + V3 + by + Subject.

examples.hi: वह एक पत्र लिखता है।

examples.en: A letter is written by him.
examples.hi: उसके द्वारा एक पत्र लिखा जाता है।
